Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original architectural portfolio photograph for a fictional Baghdad signage studio website.
Primary request: landscape 3:2 professional photo of a glass storefront for a tasteful fashion boutique in Baghdad. Beige contemporary concrete facade, muted plum and ivory accents, elegant patterned frosted window film across the lower glass, clear visibility through the upper glass into a softly lit boutique. Main focus is precise frosted glass craftsmanship and shopfront signage.
Text (verbatim): "خيط" — only this single correctly joined Arabic word, on the facade above the glass, in restrained elegant plum lettering. No other text.
Composition/framing: one coherent storefront scene, straight architectural lines, eye-level view with subtle angle and enough surroundings to feel real. 3:2 landscape.
Lighting/mood: soft Baghdad daylight, warm natural stone, photographic material detail and believable reflections.
Constraints: no people, no extra text, no watermarks, no collages, no UI, no Western-looking streetscape. Realistic photographic surfaces, not a render.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original portfolio photograph for a fictional Baghdad signage studio website.
Primary request: landscape 3:2 interior closeup photograph of a warm amber Arabic neon sign mounted on a dark sage plaster wall inside a tasteful Baghdad cafe. Include a wooden counter corner and a leafy plant below.
Text (verbatim): "على مهلك" — exact two-word Arabic phrase, correctly connected Arabic letters, right to left. No other text anywhere.
Subject: tangible flexible LED neon tubing with visible mounting clips and a convincing warm glow onto textured sage plaster; elegant legible handwritten Arabic lettering.
Composition/framing: one coherent photographic view, sign fills the upper middle part, wooden counter and plant at bottom, close enough to appreciate tubing and wall material.
Lighting/mood: atmospheric warm cafe interior, amber neon as focal light, realistic photographic detail.
Constraints: 3:2 landscape, no people, no other text, no collages, no UI, no watermarks, no digitally overlaid typography. Must be physical neon signage mounted on the wall.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original portfolio photograph for a fictional Baghdad signage studio website.
Primary request: landscape 3:2 architectural photograph of a rectangular LED screen mounted on a Baghdad electronics showroom facade after sunset. The screen displays striking orange product shapes against ink black, without any text: abstract sculptural orange consumer electronics objects, recognizable rounded earbud and speaker forms. Show realistic fine LED pixel texture, brightness and slight reflections on surroundings.
Scene/backdrop: believable urban Baghdad neighborhood storefront, blue-gray painted facade and pale concrete, neighboring local concrete and brick architecture visible at edges, practical wiring and air-conditioning details used sparingly. Warm light through showroom glass. Not a Western storefront.
Composition/framing: eye-level slightly angled architectural photograph, screen as main focal point with whole storefront visible, after-sunset deep blue ambient sky, no people.
Materials/textures: accurate physical screen frame mounted to building, textured concrete, real glass reflections and showroom depth.
Constraints: 3:2 landscape, one scene, absolutely NO TEXT anywhere, no words, no letters, no brand logos, no collages, no UI, no watermarks. Photographic realism with restrained lighting and credible proportions.
